# BatchWeaver

BatchWeaver is an Apache-2.0 proof-gated automatic batching compiler and typed
request-coalescing runtime for Go. Current public version: v@@VERSION@@.

Primary documentation:
- https://voskan.github.io/BatchWeaver/docs.html
- https://voskan.github.io/BatchWeaver/examples.html
- https://voskan.github.io/BatchWeaver/api.html
- https://voskan.github.io/BatchWeaver/status.html
- https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Voskan/BatchWeaver@v@@VERSION@@
- https://github.com/Voskan/BatchWeaver

Important limitations:
- The current release is stable v1. The Tier 1 Go API is frozen under Semantic Versioning; the bridge and adapters/* packages remain experimental.
- Unsupported transformations fail closed.
- Concrete pgx, go-redis, gqlgen, and grpc-go bindings are implemented on the
  default branch; consult the compatibility matrix for exact tested versions.
- Source is not uploaded and remote telemetry is not enabled.
- Releases currently provide checksums, SBOMs, and local unsigned provenance,
  but not cryptographic signatures or a hosted SLSA attestation.
